names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 19 mai, «Sfânta Muceniță Chiriachi».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Μαΐου, «Αγία Κυριακή η Μάρτυρας», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro's page for her: «a fost martirizată împreună cu alte șase tinere creștine în Nicomedia în anul 307» — the only year the page gives.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Μαΐου — «Αγία Κυριακή η Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar keeps «Sfânta Muceniță Chiriachi» on, and the two lines carry the same three particulars: the year 307, Nicomedia, and six other young Christian women suffering with her. saint.gr adds how they died — «αφού τις έκαψαν ζωντανές», after they had been burned alive — and names the emperor, Maximian Galerius. She is not the corpus's `kyriake-daughter-of-dorotheus`, who is kept on another day with a full life of her own. The six companions are not named on the Greek page either, so the folder stays one and not seven. No hymn is printed for her here.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

hymns.text: Muceniţa lui Hristos ne-a chemat pe noi împreună acum să cântăm cu laude luptele şi dumnezeieştile ei nevoinţe. Căci ea, ca o vitează cu cugetul, după numele ce poartă, este doamnă a gândului şi a patimilor celor necuvioase.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Condacul Sfintei Mucenițe Chiriachi», Glasul 2, podobie «Cele de sus căutând...»

english.text: The martyr of Christ has called us together now to sing with praises her struggles and her divine contests; for she, valiant in mind, is by the name she bears a lady over thought and over the unseemly passions.
